sources.content: The elsmoor-prober image runs Elsmoor, which checks that HTTP endpoints, TCP ports and DNS names respond and reports the results as metrics. It is built on debian:12-slim and runs as user ID 2000. Probe definitions are read from /etc/elsmoor/probes.yaml. Results are exposed for Prometheus on port 9471 at the /metrics path. The entrypoint is /usr/bin/elsmoor, and the default command is run. Each probe result carries the probe name as a label.

ELSMOOR_INTERVAL sets how often each probe runs and defaults to 60s. ELSMOOR_TIMEOUT defaults to 10s and must be shorter than the interval. ELSMOOR_REGION adds a region label to every result and defaults to unknown. The image needs the NET_RAW capability only if you define ICMP probes. The health check calls /healthz every 30 seconds. Elsmoor keeps no state, so the image declares no volumes. Set ELSMOOR_LOG_FORMAT to json for structured logs; it defaults to logfmt.
